topic: Australian Pilates Franchise @pilates 24/7 Sets Sights on US Expansion

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Australian Pilates Franchise @pilates 24/7 Sets Sights on US Expansion

facts.label: Article
facts.value: With 60 studios across Australia and New Zealand, the 24/7 reformer Pilates concept is preparing to enter the U.S. market with locations in Miami and Dallas Australian reformer Pilates franchise @pilates 24/7 is coming to the U.S., with plans to open its first two American studios in Miami and Dallas in early 2027. The brand, which offers members round-the-clock access to reformer Pilates through a tech-enabled, on-demand class model, currently operates 60 studios across Australia and New Zealand, serving approximately 12,000 members. Founded in 2021 by husband-and-wife duo Tara and Russell Jarrett, @pilates 24/7 has sold more than 80 franchise territories in the Asia-Pacific region, with plans to reach 100 by the end of 2027. Following the launch of its first U.S. locations, the company plans to offer franchise opportunities in Florida and Texas before expanding into additional markets. A Different Approach to Reformer Pilates Unlike traditional Pilates studios that rely on scheduled, instructor-led classes, @pilates 24/7 gives members access to reformers at any time of day, with individual screens and headphones delivering guided workouts. The company’s proprietary @p Platform features more than 700 on-demand classes from over 30 instructors, ranging from beginner to advanced Pilates, along with yoga and strength training.

en.headline: Australian Pilates Franchise @pilates 24/7 Sets Sights on US Expansion

topic: Orangetheory Fitness Becomes First Fitness Brand to Train All Coaches with NASM for the GLP-1 Era

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Orangetheory Fitness Becomes First Fitness Brand to Train All Coaches with NASM for the GLP-1 Era

facts.label: Article
facts.value: As GLP-1 medications reshape how Americans approach weight loss, Orangetheory Fitness (OTF) announced it’s the first fitness brand to partner with the National Academy of Sports Medicine (NASM) to train its entire coaching network of more than 6,500 coaches globally to support members using GLP-1 medications , an investment designed to make the brand a trusted fitness partner for members throughout their evolving health and fitness journey. For members, that means access to coaches who have received specialized education to better support their fitness needs across all OTF studios, not just a select group of specialists, along with a deeper focus on building lasting strength. OTF chose NASM for its more than 35 years of experience educating fitness professionals and its expertise translating emerging health topics into practical guidance coaches can put to work in every class. About 1 in 8 U.S. adults (12%) say they are currently taking a GLP-1 medication, according to a fall 2025 KFF poll . Yet more than half of GLP-1 users say medication alone isn’t enough for lasting results, according to a national survey conducted by Wakefield Research for OTF.

en.headline: Orangetheory Fitness Becomes First Fitness Brand to Train All Coaches with NASM for the GLP-1 Era

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Menü Linkedin Facebook Instagram Spotify Youtube Whatsapp Map-marker-alt Ergebnisse alle Ergebnisse anzeigen Ergebnisse alle Ergebnisse anzeigen Results See all results Ergebnisse alle Ergebnisse anzeigen Menü Home > YTTP eröffnet fünftes Berliner Studio Die fM Redaktion November 17, 2026 Lesezeit: 2 Minuten Mit 35 Reformern auf 300 Quadratmetern erweitert YTTP sein Berliner Studioangebot. Die Eröffnung in Prenzlauer Berg ist eine von vier geplanten Studioeröffnungen im vierten Quartal 2026. AUF EINEN BLICK Studioeröffnung: YTTP hat sein fünftes Reformer-Pilates-Studio in Berlin eröffnet. Standort: Das neue Studio befindet sich in der Backfabrik in der Saarbrücker Straße 36 bis 38 in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. Ausstattung: Auf 300 Quadratmetern stehen 35 Reformer der Marke Your Reformer, die in Deutschland von Matrix vertrieben werden. Expansion: Im vierten Quartal 2026 eröffnet YTTP insgesamt vier Studios. Eröffnung: Das neue Studio wurde mit mehreren Community Classes und einem Brunch für Gäste aus der Berliner Fitnessbranche und der Investorenszene eröffnet. Die in Köln gegründete Boutique-Kette YTTP (Your Transformation to Power) hat am Wochenende 14./ 15. November 2026 ihr fünftes Reformer-Studio in Berlin eröffnet. Mit mehreren Community Classes, einem Brunch für Gäste aus der Berliner Fitnessbranche und der Investorenszene hat YTTP das Studio eröffnet.
